title: media_db: duplicate SELECT_COLS constants, ref borrow on Copy
description:
Two minor issues in fieldwork-db/src/media_db.rs:

1. SELECT_COLS_PG and SELECT_COLS_SQ (lines 78-81) are identical strings. All other db modules use a single constant. This creates a maintenance risk where one gets updated but not the other.

2. insert_media binds user_id and persona_id by reference (.bind(&media.user_id), .bind(&media.persona_id)) but these are i64 (Copy type). Every other db module correctly passes i64 by value. The unnecessary reference is harmless but inconsistent.
close_reason: Duplicate of fedistract-xzkb.28 (already filed, covers the SELECT_COLS part). The ref-borrow-on-Copy issue is too minor to file separately.
